ideas.pitch: An AI-powered biomedical signal denoising and anomaly detection platform tailored for real-time ECG and EEG stream analysis.
ideas.title: SignalPulse AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since this is an IEEE Signal Processing Society (SPS) hackathon, judges will heavily favor mathematical and signal-processing rigor over generic web wrappers, directly matching signal-processing themes.

ideas.pitch: Satellite telemetry and RF signal anomaly detection system utilizing spatial-temporal time series forecasting.
ideas.title: AeroView Signal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the rigorous time-series forecasting approach seen in winning predictive modeling hacks, impressing engineering-heavy IEEE judges.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent research paper assistant designed specifically for IEEE Signal Processing transactions and archive mining.
ideas.title: SpectraRAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages multi-agent architectures that have proven successful at academic-backed technical hackathons.

ideas.pitch: Smart meter power load signal disaggregation and forecasting platform for predictive energy distribution analysis.
ideas.title: SmartGrid SigFlow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a tangible industrial and signal-processing problem with calibrated statistical models.

ideas.pitch: Real-time browser-based acoustic signal classification and noise filtration dashboard using WebAudio API and lightweight neural networks.
ideas.title: AudioLens DSP
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates complex client-side digital signal processing in real-time, appealing to IEEE hardware and software intersection judges.
